adaptation: src/h8h_internal_irqs.h; internal vectors 20..63 plus prequalified NMI latch only; no external pins, MMIO, device services, CPU callback or DMA implementation.
controller_adaptation: src/h8h_irq_controller.h adds H8H external IRQ pins, NMI edge qualification parameter, IER/ISR/ISCR/ICR and upstream publication points; not a CPU or scheduler. Same pinned sources as the internal subset.
